title: When No Results Does Not Mean No Evidence: A Failure-Transparency Protocol for Scientific Tool Use
summary: Scientific assistants increasingly gather evidence through tools that aggregate multiple external sources. A record list alone does not reveal whether an empty result reflects a completed search, incomplete coverage, or total upstream failure. This paper develops a failure-transparency protocol that separates record identity, request coverage, and claim support. review.reason: Proposes a protocol separating record identity, coverage, and claim support for empty results.
